content_zh:
“哦？不好说？如何个不好说法？”孔惊风有趣的看着自己这位侄女，含笑问道。
“三人表现，与以往传言大不相同。”乌倩倩皱紧了秀眉，道：“传言中，石千山老成持重，能够独当一面，处事面面俱到，滴水不漏。但这一次，却是让人一见之下，大失所望。”
“而那二弟子楚阳，传言中沉默寡言，木讷孤僻，但今日却是锋芒隐隐，看似胆小怕事，但骨子里，却……”乌倩倩想了想，说不出合适的形容词，只好道：“总之……这个人，很奇怪，我看不透他。至于三弟子谈昙，倒真的是与传言一般，超级得不着调。”
她说完，两人都沉默了下来，紧紧地锁着眉头，一言不发。良久，乌云凉长身而起，缓步走到墙前，伸手一揭，墙上一大幅壁画刷的一声挪开，露出里面一白纸。
白纸上，从上到下在左侧有一列人名，共计四十个。每一个人名的后面，都用红笔打了一个对勾。
有十几个，打了两个对勾；还有两个人，占据第一位和第二位，名字后面是三个对勾。这两个人名分别是：雪夜梦、秦慕殇。
李剑吟的名字，在第十九位，而石千山的名字，在第十三位。上面，却没有楚阳和谈昙的名字。
乌云凉提着笔，沉默了一下，然后一道红杠画在了李剑吟的名字上。将李剑吟三个字，抹去了。
然后他慎重的考虑了一下，在最下面，写上了两个字：楚阳。
然后在楚阳名字后面，加上了一个“？”号。然后他退后两步，皱着眉头想了想，却又大笔一挥，将楚阳的名字再度抹去了。只留下了一个“？”。
“此事，恐怕会引起轩然大波。”孔惊风皱着眉头：“我们天外楼现在本就是内部动荡不稳，如今又出了这件事情，将孟师弟也牵扯了进来……”
“孟师弟牵扯不进来的。以他的脾气，除非天外楼覆灭，否则，其他的事，他一概不会放在心上。”乌云凉摇了摇头，口气却很肯定。然后脸色一暗，道：“那石千山……当真如此不堪？”口气中，竟然似有失望之意。
“是。”乌倩倩对石千山的印象差极，这个平常被人夸做“成熟稳重”的石千山，在她的心里，直接就是一个超级二百五，而且还是瞎了眼睛的二百五。
无可救药！
乌云凉深深叹了口气。
对于这件事，两人并没有多说，显然并没有放在心上。毕竟，只是小辈之间打闹了一次，无关大局。现在，两人脸上都有忧虑之色，显然另有烦心之事。
乌云凉挥了挥手，乌倩倩会意，悄无声息的退了下去。
书房中，又只剩下两人。
“大哥，小弟的建议……”孔惊风试探着道。
“不急。”乌云凉摆了摆手，神色忧虑。

孔惊风沉默了一会，才又沉沉的道：“我天外楼，传至我们这一代，才仅仅是第七代。第一代祖师创立宗门，跻身于下三天七大顶尖门派之中，享受皇家供奉！何等的荣宠风光。但第二代，就与大赵皇家决裂，从此声名一落千丈，门派高手，被追杀海捕，身陨大半。好不容易在二代祖师晚年无意中帮了皇家大忙，与皇家也不复旧好。但也勉强获得了休养生息，得以重归九峰一园。”
“第三代长辈，个个惊采绝艳，都是不世人杰，本以为本门就此中兴，却没想到，正因为人才鼎盛，却引发了九峰一园内部纷争。一场激战，自相残杀，天外楼元气大伤，只是留下了门下弟子严禁自相残杀的命令。”
“但到现在，九峰一园除了孟师弟的紫竹园之外，又已经干戈隐隐，暗潮汹涌！下一届第八代弟子之中，十大弟子之位，又是一场生死厮杀。门派实力大损，已可预见。”
“我天外楼从当年的顶尖宗门，落到现在挂在二流门派……”孔惊风一开始的声音很谨慎，但慢慢地越说越是激昂：“大师兄，九峰一园，看起来规模宏大，但却是各自有各自的心思。有，不如无！”
“如此分散，内奸层出不穷。我天外楼危机重重啊……当年七大宗门，如今只余六个。剩下的一个名额，红尘轩、心剑斋虎视眈眈，觊觎已久。乃是最有力的竞争对手！而，神刀阁和黑血盟与我们仇深似海，更是亡我之心不死……”

"Oh? It's hard to say? What's the best way to put it?" Kong Jingfeng looked at his niece with interest and asked with a smile.
"The performance of the three of them is very different from the previous rumors." Wu Qianqian frowned and said: "In the rumors, Shi Qianshan is mature and prudent, able to act independently, and handles everything in an all-round way. But this time, people are disappointed at first sight."
"And the second disciple Chu Yang is rumored to be taciturn, dull and withdrawn, but today he has a faint edge. He seems to be timid and fearful, but deep down, he is..." Wu Qianqian thought for a while and couldn't think of a suitable adjective, so she could only say: "In short... this person is very strange. I can't see through him. As for the third disciple Tan Tan, he is really as out of tune as the rumors say."
After she finished speaking, both of them fell silent, frowning tightly and saying nothing. After a long time, Wu Yunliang stood up, walked slowly to the wall, reached out and lifted it up, and a large mural on the wall moved away with a brush, revealing a white paper inside.
On the white paper, there is a column of names on the left side from top to bottom, forty in total. Behind each person's name, there was a check mark in red pen.
There are more than a dozen, with two check marks; there are two people, occupying the first and second positions, with three check marks after their names. The names of these two people are: Xue Ye Meng and Qin Mu Shang.
Li Jianyin's name is at the 19th place, while Shi Qianshan's name is at the 13th place. On it, there were no names of Chu Yang and Tan Tan.
Wu Yunliang held the pen and was silent for a moment, then drew a red line on Li Jianyin's name. Erase the three words Li Jianyin.
Then he thought carefully and wrote two words at the bottom: Chu Yang.
Then, a "?" was added after Chu Yang's name. Then he took two steps back, frowned and thought for a while, but then wiped out Chu Yang's name again with a stroke of his pen. Only a "?" is left.
"This matter may cause an uproar." Kong Jingfeng frowned: "Our Tianwai Building is already experiencing internal turmoil, and now this incident has occurred, involving Junior Brother Meng..."
"Junior Brother Meng cannot be involved. With his temper, unless the Tianwai Tower is destroyed, he will not take anything else to heart." Wu Yunliang shook his head, but his tone was very sure. Then his face darkened and he said, "Is that Shi Qianshan... really so unbearable?" There seemed to be disappointment in his tone.
"Yes." Wu Qianqian had a very bad impression of Shi Qianshan. This Shi Qianshan, who was usually praised as "mature and steady", in her heart, was just a super 250, and a blind 250 at that.
Hopeless!
Wu Yunliang sighed deeply.
The two of them didn't say much about this matter, and they obviously didn't take it to heart. After all, it was just a fight between juniors and had nothing to do with the overall situation. Now, both of them had worried looks on their faces, and it was obvious that they had something else to worry about.
Wu Yunliang waved his hand, and Wu Qianqian understood and retreated quietly.
There were only two people left in the study room again.
"Brother, my little brother's suggestion..." Kong Jingfeng tentatively said.
"No rush." ​​Wu Yunliang waved his hand, looking worried.
Kong Jingfeng was silent for a while, and then said solemnly: "My Tianwai Tower is only the seventh generation passed down to our generation. The first generation founder founded the sect, ranked among the seven top sects in the next three days, and enjoyed the royal worship! What an honor and favor. But the second generation, He broke up with the imperial family of Great Zhao, and his reputation plummeted. The masters of the sect were hunted down and most of their bodies were destroyed. Finally, the second-generation ancestor accidentally helped the imperial family in his later years, and the relationship with the imperial family was no longer on good terms, but he managed to recuperate and return to the Nine Peaks Garden."
"The third-generation elders are all stunningly beautiful and outstanding. I thought that our sect would be revived, but I didn't expect that just because of the prosperity of talents, it caused a catastrophe in Jiufeng Garden."Ministry disputes. After a fierce battle and killing each other, Tianwailou's vitality was severely damaged, but he only left an order to strictly prohibit the disciples from killing each other. "
"But now, apart from Junior Brother Meng's Purple Bamboo Garden, Jiufeng Garden has been at war with each other, and the undercurrent is surging! Among the next eighth-generation disciples, the position of the top ten disciples will be another life-and-death fight. The sect's strength has suffered a huge loss, which is foreseeable. "
"My Tianwai Pavilion has fallen from the top sect back then to the second-rate sect now..." Kong Jingfeng's voice was cautious at first, but gradually became more and more passionate: "Elder brother, the Nine Peaks Garden looks huge in scale, but each one has its own thoughts. It’s better to have nothing than nothing! "
“It’s so spread out and there are so many traitors. My Tianwai Tower is in great danger... There were seven major sects in the past, but now there are only six left. Hongchenxuan and Xinjianzhai have been coveting the remaining spot for a long time. It is the most powerful competitor! However, the Divine Sword Pavilion and the Black Blood Alliance have a deep hatred for us, and they are even more determined to kill me..."
